newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but was weaker versus the pound on Monday in line with international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.194 against the dollar from 20.213 last Friday. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.389 for one pound from 32.180 last Friday.
Dealers said the rupee's fixing reflected the dollar's trend in international markets.

"On the local front, things are quiet. A few (commercial) banks have indicated a shortage in their forex reserves on importers' demand and if it more become so, the central bank might get in the market at a later stage," one dealer said.
Last week, the central bank intervened twice by selling dollars in the interbank forex market to relieve shortages at commercial banks, dealers said.
